title: Nimbus Engine (Modern re-creation of RPG Maker XP )

posts.author: _Chronos_
posts.body:
Nimbus is a recreation of RPG Maker XP with modern tools and a simplified C# scripting language called Nimbus Script with Ruby like Syntax and a familiar RPG Maker interface.
Development is super early, working prototypes of Nimbus Script and the Visual script actually DO work.
Features:
Familiar RPG Maker like editor​
Nimbus Scripting Language(static and dynamically typed) and Visual Nimbus​
2D Lighting​
Mode7 baked in (simple toggle in map settings)​
HD-2D Rendering When toggled the canvas goes into a traditional 3d Canvas over a 2D one​
TileD like Tile Mapping with a Free toggle (paint tiles in 1x1)​
Sprite Animator​
Autotile Amimator / Creator​
Tile Collision Mapper (not doing a pass/no-pass/z-order like RM)​
Full .Net 10 stack, programmed in C# 14​
C# Libraries add more features to your project,  whenever you create a .cs library it scaffolds and auto generates a nimbus script for you​
More to be added before alpha versions​
​
If you have any features you want added don't hesitate to request.  Before launch there will be a Legend of Mana and Final Fantasy templates you can use to make your game,  Nimbus does not ship with a default battle system as this is left up to the user, but all the familiar RPG mechanics will be in by default.
There is no ETA for a release.
Ignore the C#/TS toggle button, we went with a custom simplified C# .net language instead.
For anything that is not default for example a battle system all the bulk work is in C# then you script with Nimbus Script or Visual Nimbus Script.  C# is for your libraries, .ns .nvs is for your game.
​
